fieldguide.minecraft.jungle_sapling.desc: A type of tree found in rare jungle biomes. Can grow into a mega variant.
lore.fieldguide.field_guide: A journal that records the creatures, plants, and items you discover. Look at things, or scan them by holding use, to fill in new entries.
lore.fieldguide.page: Loose notes that fill in an entry of your Field Guide.
fieldguide.minecraft.azalea_leaves.descr: Gnarled azalea roots that grow from floor to ceiling in lush caves like natural support pillars, sprouting azalea leaves along their length. Their leaves drop Gloamwood Saplings, which grow into tall, spindly Gloamwood Trees.
fieldguide.minecraft.pale_oak_sapling.de: Tall, spindly trees found in the Pale Garden, a rare hollow at the heart of lush caves. Pale hanging moss drapes from the leaves, and some trunks hide a Creaking Heart.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.ashroot_s: Small, stubby trees with round, bulb-shaped crowns that grow from patches of damp Cave Crud deep underground, below sea level.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.cherry_bu: A low, pink-flowered bush that grows in cherry groves and plains. A good source of pink dye.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.midnight_: A dusky purple lily that grows in mangrove swamps and bayous. It is a source of purple dye and an ingredient in swampy dishes.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.pink_wate: A tall pink lotus that rises from the water among lily pads. It doesn't grow wild: using bone meal on a lily pad spreads more pads and sometimes sprouts one.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.poreshroo: A spongy cave mushroom that sprouts from patches of Cave Crud deep underground, below sea level. It can grow into a giant Poreshroom, and is used in a few hearty dishes.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.saffron_b: A low, yellow-flowered bush found in forests, sunflower plains and autumnal forests. A good source of yellow dye.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.umbra_bus: A low bush with near-black blooms that grows in gloomy places like dark taigas and dark swamps. A good source of black dye.
fieldguide.abundant_atmosphere.violet_wa: A rare violet lotus that rises from the water among lily pads. It doesn't grow wild: using bone meal on a lily pad very occasionally sprouts one.
fieldguide.architects_palette.twisted_sa: A gnarled tree with purplish wood that never grows wild. Tossing any sapling through a Nether Portal warps it into a Twisted Sapling.
fieldguide.autumnity.foul_berry_bush.des: A young foul berry bush, grown by planting Foul Berry Pips. Given time it matures into a Tall Foul Berry Bush that bears fruit.
fieldguide.autumnity.tall_foul_berry_bus: A tall bush found in autumnal forests and maple forests, heavy with Foul Berries. The berries are disgusting on their own, but anything eaten afterwards doubles in quality.
A small fruit tree found in forests. Its leaves blossom and then hang ripe Apples beneath them, which can be picked by hand and grow back after harvest.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.golden_apple_s: A rare, shimmering fruit tree that only bears fruit in the dark. Golden Apples left hanging in bright light wither into Withered Golden Apples, so the tree is best grown underground or under cover.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.hoary_apple_sa: An ancient fruit tree that hangs Hoary Apples from its leaves. It is never found wild: its Hoary Seeds are dug up by Sniffers, and planted seeds slowly grow into a sapling.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.honeysuckle.de: A sweet-scented flowering shrub found in forests, flower forests and dark forests. Its blossoms brew into tea, scent candles, and give yellow dye.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.leeks.descript: A crop grown from Leek Seeds. Wild Leeks grow in plains and along rivers, and harvesting them gives the first Leeks and seeds.
A fruit tree that grows along lush, blackwater and desert rivers. Its blossoms give way to hanging Lemons, which can be picked by hand and grow back after harvest.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.orange_sapling: A fruit tree found in jungles and sparse jungles. Its blossoms give way to hanging Oranges, which can be picked by hand and grow back after harvest.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.palm_sapling.d: A tall, curving tree crowned with broad fronds, found on beaches and in deserts. Coconuts cluster beneath the crown, and planting a Coconut grows a new palm.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.plum_sapling.d: A fruit tree that grows in flower forests and meadows. Its blossoms give way to hanging Plums, which can be picked by hand and grow back after harvest.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.tea_shrub.desc: A leafy shrub that grows in jungles and sparse jungles. Its fresh Tea Leaves steep into green tea, or can be dried for black tea.
fieldguide.bountifulfares.violet_bellflo: A nodding purple flower found in birch forests, flower forests, meadows and taigas. It brews into tea, scents candles, and gives purple dye.
fieldguide.buzzier_bees.buttercup.descri: A glossy yellow flower that carpets sunflower plains. A source of yellow dye.
fieldguide.buzzier_bees.pink_clover.desc: A soft pink clover that grows in birch forests. A source of pink dye.
fieldguide.buzzier_bees.white_clover.des: A small white clover that grows in forests and windswept forests. A source of white dye.
fieldguide.caverns_and_chasms.false_hope: A lone golden flower found in caves a little below the surface, growing from a small patch of grass in the dark. A source of yellow dye.
A tiny green flower that doesn't grow wild. Deepers sometimes spawn wearing a tuft of it on their heads, and scatter Moschatel across the ground when they explode.
fieldguide.culturaldelights.avocado_sapl: A leafy fruit tree found growing wild in jungles. Its thin branches end in round canopies, and Avocados hang beneath its blossoming leaves. A planted Avocado Pit will sprout into a new tree.
fieldguide.culturaldelights.corn.descrip: A tall crop grown from Corn Kernels. Wild Corn grows in plains, and its kernels can also be fed to Chickens, Ducks and Turkeys to send them hunting for Wormy Dirt.
fieldguide.culturaldelights.cucumbers.de: A crop grown from Cucumber Seeds. Wild Cucumbers grow in swamps, and harvesting them gives the first Cucumbers and seeds.
fieldguide.culturaldelights.eggplants.de: A crop grown from Eggplant Seeds. Wild Eggplants grow in jungles, and harvesting them gives the first Eggplants and seeds.
fieldguide.environmental.bird_of_paradis: A striking orange and blue tall flower that grows in jungles. A good source of orange dye.
fieldguide.environmental.blue_delphinium: A tall spire of blue blossoms found in flower forests. A source of light blue dye.
fieldguide.environmental.bluebell.descri: A drooping blue flower that grows in the shade of dark forests. A source of blue dye.
fieldguide.environmental.cartwheel.descr: A pink, wheel-shaped flower that turns up rarely in grassy places across the Overworld. A source of pink dye.
fieldguide.environmental.cup_lichen.desc: A pale, cup-shaped lichen that grows in small patches on the forest floor of taigas, dark taigas and frozen woods.
fieldguide.environmental.dianthus.descri: A frilly lime-green flower, a source of lime dye.
fieldguide.environmental.magenta_hibiscu: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of magenta dye.
fieldguide.environmental.orange_hibiscus: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of orange dye.
fieldguide.environmental.pink_delphinium: A tall spire of pink blossoms found in flower forests. A source of pink dye.
fieldguide.environmental.pink_hibiscus.d: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of pink dye.
fieldguide.environmental.purple_delphini: A tall spire of purple blossoms found in flower forests. A source of purple dye.
fieldguide.environmental.purple_hibiscus: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of purple dye.
fieldguide.environmental.red_hibiscus.de: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of red dye.
fieldguide.environmental.red_lotus_flowe: A deep red lotus with layered petals, a source of red dye.
fieldguide.environmental.tasselflower.de: A tufted orange flower that grows in savannas. A source of orange dye.
fieldguide.environmental.violet.descript: A small purple flower found in dark taigas and frozen woods. A source of purple dye.
fieldguide.environmental.white_delphiniu: A tall spire of white blossoms found in flower forests. A source of white dye.
fieldguide.environmental.white_lotus_flo: A pure white lotus with layered petals, a source of white dye.
fieldguide.environmental.yellow_hibiscus: A large tropical bloom found on rare hibiscus bushes in jungles, growing alongside hibiscus of other colours. A source of yellow dye.
fieldguide.etcetera.cotton.description: A crop grown from Cotton Seeds that blooms into fluffy Cotton Flowers. The flowers can be woven into String, Wool and cosy clothing.
fieldguide.minecraft.beetroots.descripti: A crop grown from Beetroot Seeds. Wild Beetroots grow on beaches, and harvesting them gives the first Beetroots and seeds.
fieldguide.minecraft.carrots.description: A crop grown by planting Carrots. Wild Carrots grow in temperate biomes, and harvesting them gives the first Carrots to plant.
fieldguide.minecraft.cave_vines.descript: Vines that hang from cave ceilings in lush caves, sometimes heavy with glowing Glow Berries. The berries make you glow when eaten, and replanting the vines takes Glow Berry Pips.
fieldguide.minecraft.potatoes.descriptio: A crop grown by planting Potatoes. Wild Potatoes grow in cool biomes, and harvesting them gives the first Potatoes to plant.
fieldguide.minecraft.sweet_berry_bush.de: A thorny bush found in taigas, snowy taigas and the Wooded Meadow that stings anything walking through it. It bears Sweet Berries, but growing a new bush takes Sweet Berry Pips.
fieldguide.minecraft.tall_seagrass.descr: A taller form of seagrass that sways along the floors of oceans and rivers. It can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.neapolitan.banana_frond.descr: A broad-leaved plant that grows a tall, scaly stalk topped with fronds, common in jungles and bamboo jungles and rarely found on beaches. Banana Bundles hang from the stalk and break open into Banana Bunches.
fieldguide.neapolitan.strawberry_bush.de: A low bush found in plains and the Strawberry Fields, bearing bright red Strawberries. New bushes are grown from Strawberry Pips, and bushes grown very high up may bear White Strawberries.
fieldguide.newworld.fir_sapling.descript: Tall, narrow conifers that dot meadows and the Wooded Meadow, and stand scattered through taiga forests. Some grow with a bee nest tucked into their branches.
fieldguide.nomansland.aconite.descriptio: A tall blue flower found in meadows, taigas, dark taigas and the Lavender Field. A source of blue dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.autumnal_oak_sapli: An oak that turns fiery orange and red, found in autumnal forests, boreal forests and bogs. Some of its leaves bear Pears.
fieldguide.nomansland.barrel_cactus.desc: A small, round cactus that grows in deserts, desert rivers, oases and savannas. Smelting it gives green dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.blue_flowerbed.des: A low carpet of tiny blue flowers that spreads across the ground in jungles, bayous, lush rivers and taigas.
fieldguide.nomansland.blue_lupine.descri: A tall spike of blue blossoms found in plains, prairies, taigas, dark taigas, windswept hills and snowy plains. A source of light blue dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.buddy.description: A gentle mushroom creature that lives at the centre of a fairy ring of Field Mushrooms in mushroom fields, capped with a mushroom of its own. Feed it mushrooms or mushroom dishes to make it happy; if it dies it drops its mushrooms and, in time, returns to its ring.
fieldguide.nomansland.cave_weeds.descrip: Pale, wiry weeds that grow on the floors of caves throughout the underground. They are one of the few plants that need no light at all.
fieldguide.nomansland.dried_grass.descri: Brittle, sun-bleached grass that grows in bogs, mud beaches and mushroom fields. It can only be collected with Shears, and can be bundled into thatch.
fieldguide.nomansland.duckweed.descripti: A floating mat of tiny leaves that covers still water in swamps, bayous, bogs and blackwater rivers, and the pools of lush caves. It can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.nomansland.fiddlehead.descrip: The curled young shoot of a fern, found in swamps, bogs, bayous and the darker forests.
fieldguide.nomansland.frienderman.descri: A rare, peaceful cousin of the Wanderer that occasionally appears in the Overworld in a Wanderer's place. It vanishes if you get close or strike it, but look at it and it will teleport in front of you to stare; wear an Ancient Bronze Mask and it tosses you a gift, such as Wanderer Pearls or an explorer's map.
fieldguide.nomansland.frosted_grass.desc: Grass coated in a thin rime of frost, found in snowy plains, groves, snowy taigas, frozen woods and other cold places.
fieldguide.nomansland.grass_sprouts.desc: Short tufts of new grass that sprout across grassy ground throughout the Overworld.
fieldguide.nomansland.ground_ivy.descrip: A low, creeping ivy that carpets the floor of jungles, dark forests and other lush places.
fieldguide.nomansland.huge_field_mushroo: A giant, pale-capped mushroom that grows in mushroom fields. Bone meal can grow a Field Mushroom into one.
fieldguide.nomansland.lavender_bush.desc: A fragrant purple bush that fills the Lavender Field and grows in meadows. It brews into lavender tea and gives purple dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.maple_sapling.desc: A green-leaved maple found in maple forests, maple groves and snowy taigas. A tap on its trunk slowly drips Maple Syrup into a cauldron below.
fieldguide.nomansland.mycelium_growths.d: Small purple fungal growths that sprout from mycelium in mushroom fields. They can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.nomansland.mycelium_sprouts.d: Tiny fungal sprouts that grow from mycelium in mushroom fields. They can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.nomansland.oat_grass.descript: Tall, feathery wild grass found in prairies, birch forests, cherry groves, autumnal forests, the Lavender Field and on grassy beaches.
fieldguide.nomansland.pale_cherry_saplin: A cherry tree with pale, almost white blossoms that grows among the pink trees of cherry groves.
fieldguide.nomansland.pickleweed.descrip: A fleshy, salt-loving plant that grows in swamps and bogs. A source of brown dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.pine_sapling.descr: A tall, sparse conifer common in taigas, boreal forests, dark taigas and windswept hills, with young pines dotting the prairie. A tap on its trunk slowly drips sticky Resin into a cauldron below.
fieldguide.nomansland.pink_lupine.descri: A tall spike of pink blossoms found in plains, forests, birch forests, cherry groves, bogs and the Lavender Field.
fieldguide.nomansland.rafflesia.descript: An enormous, foul-smelling flower that lies flat on the floor of jungles, bayous and lush rivers. A source of red dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.red_flowerbed.desc: A low carpet of tiny red flowers found in dark forests, maple forests, old growth forests, autumnal forests and boreal forests. A source of red dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.red_lupine.descrip: A tall spike of red blossoms found in autumnal forests, boreal forests, maple forests, dark forests, bogs, plains and taigas.
A maple with brilliant red leaves that colours maple forests, maple groves, autumnal forests and boreal forests. A tap on its trunk slowly drips Maple Syrup into a cauldron below.
fieldguide.nomansland.short_beachgrass.d: A short, sandy-coloured grass that grows on the sand of beaches. It can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.nomansland.starflower.descrip: A small white star-shaped flower that blooms in snowy plains and frozen woods. A source of white dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.succulent.descript: A plump little succulent that grows in deserts, desert rivers, oases and savannas, with a hardier kind in jungles and bayous.
fieldguide.nomansland.tall_beachgrass.de: A tall, sandy-coloured grass that grows on the sand of beaches. It can only be collected with Shears.
fieldguide.nomansland.thistle.descriptio: A spiky purple flower found in plains, meadows, savannas, windswept hills and the Lavender Field. A source of purple dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.violet_flowerbed.d: A low carpet of tiny violet flowers found in jungles, savannas, taigas, cherry groves, meadows, windswept hills and the Lavender Field.
fieldguide.nomansland.walnut_sapling.des: A tall, broad-crowned tree found in dark forests, dark taigas, dark swamps and old growth forests. Clusters of Walnuts hang from its leaves and drop to the ground when ripe.
fieldguide.nomansland.water_mosaic.descr: A floating plant with red, tile-like leaves that spreads across the water of mangrove swamps and bayous. A source of red dye.
fieldguide.nomansland.white_flowerbed.de: A low carpet of tiny white flowers found in plains, forests, birch forests, flower forests, snowy plains, cherry groves and meadows.
fieldguide.nomansland.willow_sapling.des: A drooping tree of swamps, bayous, bogs, dark swamps and blackwater rivers, often rooted right at the water's edge.
fieldguide.nomansland.yellow_birch_sapli: A birch with golden yellow leaves that brightens forests, autumnal forests and old growth birch forests.
fieldguide.nomansland.yellow_flowerbed.d: A low carpet of tiny yellow flowers found in plains, forests, sunflower plains, old growth birch forests, jungles and autumnal forests.
fieldguide.nomansland.yellow_lupine.desc: A tall spike of yellow blossoms found in plains, sunflower plains, prairies, forests, old growth birch forests, autumnal forests and boreal forests.
fieldguide.snowyspirit.ginger.descriptio: A crop grown from Ginger. Wild Ginger grows in jungles and is especially common in sparse jungles; its spicy root is the key to Gingerbread.
fieldguide.supplementaries.wild_flax.des: A wild, blue-flowered flax plant whose fibres can be spun into string.
fieldguide.tide.chorus_cod.description: A strange fish that lives in partnership with the chorus flower growing from its back, feeding it in return for a free meal. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.elytrout.description: An elegant, insect-like fish whose fins resemble the wings of an elytra. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.ender_glider.description: A winged, alien-looking fish that glides swiftly through the water. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.enderfin.description: A fish with metallic, deep blue skin that gives it a pearl-like sheen. One of the commoner catches when fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.endergazer.description: A small fish whose head is one enormous eye, serving as both its sight and its brain. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.pale_clubfish.descriptio: An oddly club-shaped fish and the most common catch in Dimensional Tears, a tasty snack for predators and anglers alike. Fishing in Dimensional Tears needs an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.snatcher_squid.descripti: A huge and rarely caught squid that drags its prey down into the crushing depths of the void. Hooked by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook, and a hard fight to land.
fieldguide.tide.violet_carp.description: A carp of vivid violet colours whose origin no one has ever explained. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.tide.voidseeker.description: An extremely rare fish that hops between dimensions to avoid being caught. Eating one sends you straight back to your respawn point. Caught by fishing in Dimensional Tears with an Adamantite hook.
fieldguide.upgrade_aquatic.flowering_rus: A tall pink-flowered rush that grows in the shallows of rivers. A good source of pink dye.
fieldguide.upgrade_aquatic.pink_searocke: A hardy pink flower that grows in the sand of beaches. A source of pink dye.
fieldguide.upgrade_aquatic.white_searock: A hardy white flower that grows in the sand of beaches. A source of white dye.
fieldguide.wilderflowers.cheery_wildflow: A cheerful scatter of yellow wildflowers found in flower forests, meadows, sunflower plains and sparse jungles, and thickest in birch forests. They can be woven into a garland.
fieldguide.wilderflowers.hopeful_wildflo: A soft scatter of pink wildflowers found in flower forests. They can be woven into a garland.
fieldguide.wilderflowers.moody_wildflowe: A moody scatter of purple wildflowers found in flower forests, windswept hills and snowy taigas, and thickest in taigas. They can be woven into a garland.
fieldguide.spicedcider.cacao_sapling.des: A small jungle tree whose thin trunk forks into a few crooked branches, each topped with a round canopy. Cacao Pods hang beneath its leaves and ripen into Cocoa Beans.
fieldguide.spicedcider.pear_sapling.desc: A small fruit tree of autumnal forests, with a thin trunk and a few upturned branches under a rounded crown. Pears hang beneath its blossoming leaves.
